Is this path reachable from input the caller does not control, and is the comparison that guards it case-insensitive? Under P7 a write here is code execution rather than I/O — the file is loaded by an agent, so writing it is indistinguishable from running it. A denylist checking `.claude` blocks `.CLAUDE` on Linux and fails to on macOS, and that assumption is itself the finding.
